title: Un-forwardable-pile measurement implemented twice: warnings.odin inline loop vs node_health_measure
detail: Two code sites implement the identical stuck-pile÷throughput measure. Any semantic change (waiting_ticks, bandwidth, throughput) is now a two-site edit; the coherence test catches output drift only after the fact. The PR's 'one measurement family, two consumers' is not realized in code.
recommended_fix: Have warning_evaluate's node pass consume node_health_measure per slot (or extract a shared stuck-load accumulator both passes read) — one implementation, two consumers; the never-serialized node_health array separation is unchanged.

title: Hover inspect card ignores the repo's entity-anchored-panel clamp convention (off-window / under tray)
detail: The existing anchored-panel pattern (popover_rect) documents and implements viewport + tray-band clamping because the window is resizable and nodes sit anywhere on the map. The new card anchors below-right unclamped, clipping off-screen for edge nodes.
recommended_fix: Clamp the card rect the way popover_rect does (flip left near the right edge, clamp into v.win_w/v.win_h, clear of TRAY_CLEAR) — the View already carries win_w/win_h.

title: Input sampling + world picking inside draw_hud instead of handle_input
evidence:
app/main.odin:1215-1226 (inside draw_hud :: proc at 1106): `if (app.mode == .Run || app.mode == .Paused) && app.placing < 0 && !app.drag.active {
		mx, my := rl.GetMouseX(), rl.GetMouseY()
		wx, wy := rnd.from_screen(&app.view, f32(mx), f32(my))
		if id, ok := snap_node(app, wx, wy); ok {`. The only other mouse reads in main.odin are 526 (handle_input: `mx, my := rl.GetMouseX(), rl.GetMouseY()` after the key handling) and 939 (mouse_tile helper); draw_demolish_popover instead reads stored `app.sel_node`.
detail: Hover target is interaction state computed in the draw pass, deviating from the codebase's handle_input → App state → draw convention (sel_node, drag, glow). No test or golden can address it, and 5.4 input parity can't reach a draw-pass-only hover.
recommended_fix: Resolve the hovered node in handle_input into App state (e.g. app.hover_node, same guards), and have draw_hud only render the card from it.

title: State glyph/color vocabulary duplicated between the ring and the inspect card
detail: The lvl→glyph/color mapping exists twice in the render package; the 'mirror' is enforced by duplication, not structure, so ring and card can drift silently (no test pins the glyph strings).
recommended_fix: Extract a shared render-package helper (lvl → glyph + color) that both draw_health_ring and node_health_card_state consume.
